title: a frozen statement (product_smoothing_statement) elaborates to another constant while every printed snapshot stays byte-identical: a new library GaussianAnalysis.zz.euclidean defines an alias of frobenius with the same body, and a notation at the end of the unfrozen product_smoothing.v redirects frobenius to it; the 38 short Requires of euclidean are qualified (the second library would make them ambiguous) and PsdRank/Main.v names the original in full
validation_note: The alias has the same body, so the frozen theorem still checks by conversion. The print is byte-identical (the printer shows euclidean.frobenius for the alias, and frobenius is printed nowhere else in SnapshotPhase13), so only the identity layer catches it: tested on 20 October 2026 in a copy of the tested tree, one failure, the references of IdentitySnapshotPhase13 at product_smoothing_statement.
source: the name-resolution toy of reviews/phase13-repair-review/snapshots/name-resolution-toy, on a frozen statement of the project
